title: Errata Record
description: A dated record of a claim held in a fragment, a material, or another ledger record, that no longer matches measurement. The record is not rewritten; the judgement is kept beside it, with the check that produced it. Modelled on Augustine's Retractationes and on retraction notices in publishing, not on silent correction.

params.description: All inputs needed to re-run the check. A check with unrecorded inputs is not reproducible and should be classified unmeasurable.

duplicate_of.description: Optional IDs of earlier errata rows that assert the SAME claim against the same addressee, reworded. The engine cannot judge whether two differently-worded Japanese claims are the same claim, and guessing would merge genuinely distinct corrections, so a restatement declares itself here. Exact repeats (same addressee, same claim text after whitespace/NFKC normalisation) are collapsed without a declaration. A group of rows about one claim costs one penalty, not one per row; the group still costs if any member is a live correction, so this field cannot be used to escape a penalty. Visibility is unaffected: every row stays in errata_flags.

fragment_id.description: Shortcut for subject_type='fragment'. Use either this or subject_id, not both.
